text:
Assistant A provides a comprehensive, specific, and actionable list of Japanese business etiquette norms, covering greetings (bowing), business card exchange, punctuality, dress code, language, gift-giving, and dining etiquette. This level of detail and practical guidance makes it more helpful and relevant for someone preparing to do business in Japan. Assistant B, while accurate, is much more general and lacks the concrete examples and depth that would be most useful to the user.

[[A]]
